title: Market / Region Context (light contract)
description: Written once per session by the orchestrator (main agent), alongside sector_config. Region and institutional context are agent JUDGMENT: intensity gates how deep downstream agents go. Schemas enforce structure and provenance only. Decided cost-of-capital and governance numbers live in valuation assumptions, not here as mandates. Advisory methodology: region_*.md modules named by module_file.

primary_region.description: Coarse listing/institutional region for module selection. Extend enum only when a new region_*.md ships.

intensity.description: low = typical US widely-held no-op path; medium = local CoC/accounting attention; high = control/VIE/SOE/family or hard non-US institutional risk.

confidence.description: Self-assessed. Below 0.70 -> requires_manual_review true and widen valuation range; do NOT fake primary_region=us.

module_file.description: Advisory region module, e.g. region_us.md, region_hk_china.md, region_generic.md

signals.description: Objective evidence (exchange, currency, form type, ownership headlines, ADR/home listing).

disconfirming_signals.description: Evidence against the chosen region/intensity that was weighed.

listing.description: Listing and filing identity (aligns with README required inputs).

accounting_regime.description: Primary reporting basis for peer and model comparability — not a valuation number.

basis.description: us_gaap | ifrs | hkfrs | cas | k_ifrs | local_gaap | mixed | other

cost_of_capital_flags.description: FLAGS only (booleans + notes). Judged Rf/ERP/CRP/FX values belong in valuation_model.assumptions with {value,rationale,basis}. No mandated formulas.

ownership.description: Control structure hints for 2e depth and valuation governance dials.

control_type.description: widely_held | founder_dual_class | family | soe | vie | pyramid | mixed | unknown
